paper_title: Piezoelectrically Tuned Multimode Cavity Search for Axion Dark Matter
notes: ADMX Sidecar pathfinder haloscope. New 90% CL exclusion limits on g_agamma in three frequency ranges: Run A (4202-4249 MHz, TM010, 17.38-17.57 ueV), Run B (5086-5799 MHz, TM010, 21.03-23.98 ueV), Run C (7173-7203 MHz, TM020, 29.67-29.79 ueV), assuming rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 with an isothermal halo distribution. No numerical limit table is provided; limits are shown only in Fig. 4 (y-axis 1e-13 to 1e-10 GeV^-1). The coupling values above are approximate representative levels per run, estimated from the figure description and the run parameters (Run A: B=3.11 T, C=0.49, QL=6.2k -> ~1.5e-13; Run B: low field 0.78 T commissioning, QL=2.2k -> ~1e-12; Run C: TM020 with form factor ~0.04 -> ~2e-12). Each run encoded as a flat two-point band over its stated mass range. Paper states improvement over solar (CAST) bounds by ~2 orders of magnitude, consistent with these levels.
